name: Mohammad Javadi Balakan
meta_description: Mohammad Javadi (MJ) Balakan is an experimental physicist who builds superconducting quantum devices. Research on topological superconductivity in Fe(Te,Se), 2D materials and silicon optoelectronics.
lead: I build superconducting quantum devices to find topological states for fault-tolerant qubits.
now: Research Scientist at a stealth-mode startup, San Jose, CA. Previously SUNY Albany (CNSE) and University of Tehran.

career.title: Postdoctoral Fellow → Research Scientist
